reviewer: Kimi actually viewed the exact 65x67 original, the complete approved 2048x2048 external-07 RGB parent, the complete derived RGBA raw and the full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha comparison. Checked swept dark hair, short sideburns, brows, round spectacles, smooth chin, light standing collar, dark closure, note groups, right-edge tab, backplate and silhouette. Verified parent review, alpha receipt and actual model binding; no new image generation was used for this derivative.

hair_features.reason: The thick swept-back dark hair, full hairline, short dark sideburns, dark eyebrows and round spectacles remain coherent with the visible source. The chin stays smooth without a moustache or beard, and no headgear was added.

collar_fit.reason: The light standing collar and dark central closure fit the compact head with a short broad neck transition, preserving the original closed structure without pinching, floating fabric, a long neck column or a cream bib.

entries.positive_observation: The final RGBA preserves the approved yellow mascot with dark swept hair, short sideburns, brows, round spectacles, one restrained mouth, the light jacket and its dark closure. The source-compatible viewer-left pose, blue-charcoal photographic backing, two separated irregular gray-mark groups in each note row, compact right-edge tab and blank lower paper remain, without generic dots, a wedge or a replacement scene.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept for production pending formal import. RGB is identical to the approved parent and the output alpha exactly equals the BILINEAR-resized source alpha. Source and returned extrema are 0..255. Output counts are 0=604791, 252=12711, 253=17922, 254=30920 and 255=2019694; source, resized and output corners are all 0. Full white/cyan/alpha inspection confirms the source-compatible exterior and intact opaque photographic backing and clothing with no visible interior holes or white working-matte halo.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine spectacles-rim detail, exact central closure and note glyphs remain limited by the 65x67 source. Approval covers visible hair, glasses, collar, note groups, composition and the actual exterior alpha, not invented readable text or microscopic insignia.
